'''Ubog Ozo''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who lived during the [[Third Galactic War]] at the [[Blba Groves]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="AAO" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ubog Ozo first appeared in the [[May]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Festival">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240529|text=The Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival Event has come to SWTOR!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
